name: dsh-windows-tray

one_liner.zh: 为 Windows 上的 DSH web 服务提供系统托盘控制
one_liner.en: Control the DSH web service from a Windows system tray icon

local: Windows desktop with PowerShell and DSH installed
Controls the local web service on port 3080 and opens its web URL in the browser
Writes launch output and error logs under the Windows TEMP directory

config_items.name: DSH_WEB_URL
config_items.description: Web URL opened by the tray controller

readme_mismatch: README presents DSH_NODE_EXE, DSH_RUNNER_ARG and DSH_CHECKOUT as overridable settings, while lib/tray.js sets these variables from the current process when launching PowerShell, overriding inherited values.
